parameters.name: include_preferred_tables
parameters.description: Set the flag to get the preferred tables in response.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: It is mandatory parameter to get the tables, decides table is extendible or not.

parameters.name: search_query
parameters.description: Encoded query to filter the response. (N/A preferred tables list)

parameters.name: include_out_scope
parameters.description: Set this flag to get the out-scope tables in response.

parameters.name: app_scope
parameters.description: app-scope is mandatory to get in-scope or out-scope tables.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of tables per list to be displayed in list. (N/A for preferred tables)

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Order in which in-scope or out-scope tables display. (N/A for preferred tables)

parameters.name: include_in_scope
parameters.description: Set this flag to get the in-scope tables in response.
